토요일.x: I go shopping with a friend on Saturday.
토요일.e: 'Earth day' — named for Saturn, the earth planet.

돈.x: I don't have much money this month.
돈.e: 용돈 = pocket money; 세뱃돈 = cash kids get for bowing to elders at Lunar New Year.
돈.t: Useful pairs: 돈을 벌다 (earn money), 돈을 쓰다 (spend money), 돈을 내다 (pay).

새.x: I can hear birds singing in the morning.
새.t: 새 before a noun means 'new': 새 옷 (new clothes). As a noun on its own it means 'bird'.

꿈.x: My dream is to become a teacher.
꿈.t: You 'dream a dream': 꿈을 꾸다. 어젯밤에 이상한 꿈을 꿨어요.

천천히.forms: 천천히 + verb: 천천히 말해 주세요, 천천히 드세요
천천히.x: Please speak a little more slowly.
천천히.t: 천천히 드세요 = 'Take your time eating' — a kind thing to say to guests.

동그랗다.x: The baby's eyes are round and really cute.
동그랗다.e: Related to 둥글다 'round'; the bright vowel ㅗ gives a smaller, cuter feel. The noun is 동그라미 'circle'.
동그랗다.t: Pronounced [동그라타]: ㅎ and ㄷ merge into ㅌ. As an ㅎ irregular, the ㅎ drops before endings: 동그란 얼굴 'a round face'.

다음날.m: the next day, the following day
다음날.ex: 술을 많이 마신 다음날은 머리가 아파요.
다음날.x: The day after I drink a lot, I get a headache.
다음날.e: 다음 'next' + 날 'day'; dictionaries spell it with a space: 다음 날.
다음날.t: Use 내일 for 'tomorrow' from today; use 다음날 for the day after some other event.

나르다.forms: 날라요 · 날랐어요 · 나를 거예요 · 나르세요 (르 irregular)
나르다.m: to carry, to move (things from place to place)
나르다.ex: 이삿날 친구들이 무거운 상자를 날라 줬어요.
나르다.x: On moving day, my friends carried the heavy boxes for me.
나르다.e: Don't confuse with 날다 'to fly': 날라요 is 'carry', 날아요 is 'fly'.
나르다.t: 나르다 means carrying things back and forth, often many items or heavy loads.

서서히.x: The weather is gradually getting colder.
서서히.e: Literally 'slowly, slowly' plus the adverb ending -히.
서서히.t: Usually pairs with change verbs like -아/어지다: 서서히 나아지다 'gradually get better.'

지원자.ex: 올해는 지원자가 작년보다 두 배나 많아요.
지원자.x: This year there are twice as many applicants as last year.
지원자.e: -자 = person who does it: 지원자, 연구자, 학습자.

영화감독.x: Bong Joon-ho is a world-famous Korean film director.
영화감독.t: 감독 alone also means a sports team's head coach.

연체료.x: I returned the book late, so I paid a late fee.

증명.ex: 제가 그날 집에 있었다는 걸 증명할 수 있어요.
증명.x: I can prove that I was at home that day.

달래다.m: to soothe, to calm, to comfort; to coax
달래다.x: Mom is soothing the crying baby.
달래다.e: Homonym warning: 달래요 can also be short for 달라고 해요 'they're asking for it'.

국익.ex: 정부는 무엇보다 국익을 우선으로 생각해야 합니다.
국익.x: The government must put the national interest above all else.
국익.e: Short for 국가의 이익, 'the nation's benefit'.
국익.t: Pronounced [구긱]: the batchim ㄱ carries over to the next syllable.

주파수.x: I tuned the radio frequency and listened to the news.

오염원.ex: 공장 폐수가 강의 주요 오염원으로 밝혀졌습니다.
오염원.x: Factory wastewater was found to be the river's main source of pollution.
오염원.t: Pronounced [오여뭔]: the ㅁ links over to 원 (o-yeo-mwon).

양성.ex: 다행히 혹이 양성이라서 수술만 하면 된대요.
양성.x: Luckily the lump is benign, so they say surgery alone will do.
양성.e: Literally 'good nature' — the opposite of malignant.
양성.t: Homonym warning: 양성 (陽性) also means testing positive, and 양성 (養成) means training — context decides.

넘보다.m: to have one's eye on, to covet, to aim for (something beyond reach); to look down on
넘보다.ex: 그 신생 기업이 업계 1위 자리를 넘보고 있습니다.
넘보다.x: That startup is eyeing the top spot in the industry.
넘보다.e: 넘다 'to go over' + 보다 'to look': peeking over the fence at what isn't yours.

더할 나위 없이.forms: 더할 나위 없이 + adjective · 더할 나위 없어요
더할 나위 없이.ex: 오늘은 소풍 가기에 날씨가 더할 나위 없이 좋아요.
더할 나위 없이.x: The weather today is perfect for a picnic.
더할 나위 없이.e: Literally 'with no room (나위) to add more'.
더할 나위 없이.t: As a predicate: 더할 나위 없어요 'It couldn't be better.'

순순히.ex: 범인은 결국 자신의 죄를 순순히 인정했습니다.
순순히.x: The suspect finally admitted his crime without resistance.
순순히.e: Literally 'docile, docile': going along without a fight.

거침없이.ex: 그 학생은 어려운 질문에도 거침없이 대답했어요.
거침없이.x: That student answered without hesitation, even to the hard questions.
거침없이.e: From 거치다 'to get snagged' — literally 'without catching on anything'.

틈.m: gap, crack; spare moment; opening, chance
틈.ex: 바쁜 와중에 잠깐 틈을 내서 커피를 마셨어요.
틈.x: Busy as I was, I made a moment to grab a quick coffee.
틈.e: One word covering a physical crack, a free moment, and a weak spot — all 'openings'.

일체감.ex: 월드컵 응원을 하면서 국민들이 일체감을 느꼈습니다.
일체감.x: Cheering during the World Cup, the people felt a sense of unity.

둔화세.x: The slowdown in rising prices is becoming clear.
둔화세.e: Literally 'trend of becoming dull' — growth losing its edge, slowing down.
둔화세.t: 둔화 means growth is slowing, not reversing — prices still rise, just less quickly.

머리를 싸매다.forms: 머리를 싸매고 공부하다 · 머리를 싸매고 고민했어요
머리를 싸매다.m: to study or think extremely hard, to rack one's brains (lit. to wrap up one's head)
머리를 싸매다.ex: 동생은 시험 때문에 머리를 싸매고 공부하고 있어요.
머리를 싸매다.x: My brother is studying his head off for the exam.
머리를 싸매다.e: Literally 'to bind up one's head' with a cloth, as if it aches from so much thinking.
머리를 싸매다.t: Almost always 머리를 싸매고 + 공부하다/고민하다; neutral, used for studying or solving a hard problem.

다래끼.x: I got a sty on my eye, so I went to the eye clinic.
다래끼.t: Use 다래끼가 나다 'to get a sty'. An eye clinic (안과) treats it.

공증.ex: 중요한 계약서는 공증을 받아 두는 게 좋아요.
공증.x: It's a good idea to get important contracts notarized.
공증.t: 공증을 받다 means 'to get something notarized'; a notary office is a 공증 사무소.

환차손.ex: 원화 가치가 떨어져서 수입 업체들이 환차손을 입었습니다.
환차손.x: Importers suffered currency losses as the won weakened.

누진세.ex: 누진세는 소득이 많을수록 더 높은 세율을 적용합니다.
누진세.x: A progressive tax applies a higher rate the more you earn.
누진세.e: Literally 'tax that climbs step by step'.
누진세.t: Koreans meet 누진제 in electricity bills: the more power you use, the higher the rate per unit.

예언자.ex: 그 예언자는 큰 홍수가 올 거라고 경고했어요.
예언자.x: The prophet warned that a great flood would come.
예언자.e: Literally 'a person who speaks beforehand'. -자 = person: 과학자, 운전자.

자기애.ex: 적당한 자기애는 정신 건강에 도움이 돼요.
자기애.x: A healthy amount of self-love is good for your mental health.
자기애.t: Neutral or positive in everyday talk, unlike English 'narcissism.'

각골난망.m: unforgettable gratitude, a kindness one will never forget
각골난망.ex: 어려울 때 도와주신 은혜는 정말 각골난망입니다.
각골난망.x: I will never forget the kindness you showed me in hard times.
각골난망.e: Literally 'carved into the bone, hard to forget.'
각골난망.t: Pronounced [각꼴란망]; used in formal thanks, often with 은혜 (a favor received).
rel: repaying a kindness even after death

종용하다.m: to urge, to press (someone to do something)
종용하다.x: The company pressured employees to resign.
종용하다.t: Usually implies pressure, as in 사퇴를 종용하다 = to push someone to step down.

정숙하다.x: You must stay quiet inside the exam hall.
정숙하다.e: Literally 'quiet and solemn'. A homonym means 'chaste, virtuous'.
정숙하다.t: Signs reading 정숙 mean 'Quiet, please' in libraries, hospitals and exam halls. Pronounced [정수카다].

쌀쌀맞다.x: That employee answered the customer coldly.
쌀쌀맞다.e: From 쌀쌀하다 'chilly' + -맞다 'having that quality': chilly in attitude.

응축하다.m: to condense, to compress, to concentrate
응축하다.ex: 이 시에는 시인의 삶이 짧은 문장 속에 응축되어 있어요.
응축하다.x: In this poem, the poet's life is condensed into short lines.
응축하다.e: Literally 'congeal and shrink' — vapor turning to liquid, or ideas packed tightly.

아스라하다.ex: 멀리 산봉우리가 안개 속에 아스라하게 보여요.
아스라하다.x: Far away, the mountain peaks look faint through the fog.
아스라하다.t: Used for distant sights and old memories: 아스라한 추억.

이란격석.m: a hopeless fight against overwhelming odds
이란격석.x: Fighting a big corporation alone is like throwing eggs at a rock.
이란격석.e: Literally 'striking a rock with an egg.'
이란격석.t: The everyday native equivalent is 계란으로 바위 치기.

편도체.x: The amygdala processes emotions such as fear.
편도체.e: Literally 'almond body'; 편도 means almond, as does Greek 'amygdala'.
편도체.t: Don't confuse it with 편도선 (tonsils) or 편도 (one-way ticket).

구르는 돌에는 이끼가 끼지 않는다.forms: 구르는 돌에는 이끼가 끼지 않는다고 · 구르는 돌에는 이끼가 안 낀다잖아요
구르는 돌에는 이끼가 끼지 않는다.m: a rolling stone gathers no moss; if you keep active, you won't stagnate
구르는 돌에는 이끼가 끼지 않는다.ex: 할아버지는 구르는 돌에는 이끼가 끼지 않는다며 은퇴 후에도 매일 공부하세요.
구르는 돌에는 이끼가 끼지 않는다.x: Saying a rolling stone gathers no moss, my grandfather studies every day even after retiring.
구르는 돌에는 이끼가 끼지 않는다.e: A translation of the English proverb: a stone that keeps rolling never gets covered in moss (이끼가 끼다).
구르는 돌에는 이끼가 끼지 않는다.t: Pronounced [안는다]. In Korean it is almost always positive (keep moving and you'll keep growing), not the older English sense of criticizing people who never settle down.
nb: 열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다
낮말은 새가 듣고 밤말은 쥐가 듣는다
말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다
열 길 물속은 알아도 한 길 사람 속은 모른다

개같이 벌어서 정승같이 쓴다.forms: 개같이 벌어서 정승같이 쓰라고 · 개같이 벌어서 정승같이 쓴다더니
개같이 벌어서 정승같이 쓴다.m: earn money through any honest hard work, but spend it nobly (lit. earn like a dog, spend like a high minister)
개같이 벌어서 정승같이 쓴다.ex: 개같이 벌어서 정승같이 쓰라고, 그분은 평생 모은 돈을 기부했어요.
개같이 벌어서 정승같이 쓴다.x: Earn like a dog, spend like a minister, as they say: he donated all the money he had saved over his life.
개같이 벌어서 정승같이 쓴다.e: 정승 was a top minister of the Joseon court: earn money humbly through any hard, lowly work, but spend it generously and with dignity.
개같이 벌어서 정승같이 쓴다.t: Pronounced [개가치 버러서 정승가치 쓴다]. 개같이 can sound rude on its own, but this proverb is well known and not vulgar; it is often quoted about people who donate hard-earned savings.
